summary: Tortoise Energy Infrastructure Corporation filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026 disclosing entry into a distribution agreement with PINE Distributors LLC for an at-the-market offering of up to 2,500,000 common shares, par $0.001, sold through the distributor as agent under Rule 415, with UBS Securities LLC as sub-placement agent. The offering utilizes TYG's effective Form N-2/ASR shelf (File Nos. 333-295680; 811-21462), base prospectus dated May 8, 2026 and prospectus supplement dated September 22, 2026. No price, premium, or closing date is stated; this is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation. Watch for share overhang and NAV dilution from ATM sales.
